thought.text: All service processes are gone. Let me verify all app ports are free and the docker infrastructure is still healthy:

reasoning_content: Good — no uvicorn or vite processes remain. process-compose has terminated, and all of its service coprocesses have been cleaned up. The 3 that were counted earlier were probably grep or intermediate processes. Let's confirm that the ports are open and that the docker container is still healthy, then do a clean restart.

action.command:
/workspace/.venv/bin/python -c "
res=set()
for f in ('/proc/net/tcp','/proc/net/tcp6'):
    try: lines=open(f).read().splitlines()[1:]
    except FileNotFoundError: continue
    for ln in lines:
        p=ln.split()
        if p[3]=='0A': res.add(int(p[1].split(':')[1],16))
want=[18000,18001,18002,18003,18005,18006,18007,18008,18009,18010,18011,18012,18013,18014,18015,18016,18020,18021,18022,18024,3002,8080,8000]
still=[p for p in want if p in res]
print('still listening (want none except 8000 llm-stub):', still)
"; echo "=== docker infra ==="; docker ps --format "{{.Names}}: {{.Status}}" | head -12; echo "=== LLM stub ==="; curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "llm-stub=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8000/v1/models

tool_call.name: terminal

summary: Verify ports free and docker infra healthy
